summary.short: Bill amending Brazil's competition law (Lei 12.529/2011) to let CADE designate systemically relevant digital-market firms, create a Digital Markets Superintendency within CADE, and impose special obligations on designated firms. Takes effect 60 days after publication.
summary.long: The bill amends Law 12.529/2011 to create a designation process for economic agents of systemic relevance in digital markets, decided by CADE's Tribunal on proposal of a new Digital Markets Superintendency within CADE. Designation criteria (Art. 47-C) include multi-sided markets, network effects, vertical integration, access to personal and commercial data, and number of users. Eligibility depends on group gross annual revenue above R$ 50 billion worldwide or above R$ 5 billion in Brazil (Art. 47-C §1), adjustable by joint ministerial act. A designation lasts up to ten years and covers the whole economic group (Art. 87-A). Designated agents must keep an office in Brazil and updated notification addresses (Art. 47-D); a daily fine of R$ 20,000, raisable up to fifty times, applies to failing to set up the office within the deadline (Art. 44-A). Special obligations (Art. 47-E) may include merger submission, transparency duties toward business and end users, bans on self-preferencing and tying, free data-transfer tools and interoperability, each set through a separate administrative process; they start sixty days after publication of the decision (Art. 87-B §2). Designated agents must file compliance reports (Art. 87-H). Non-compliance triggers the sanctions for economic-order infractions (Art. 47-G). The Act enters into force sixty days after publication.

notes: Annotated from the bill text as presented on 18/09/2025 (PL 4675/2025), not from a consolidated text of Lei 12.529/2011. Many internal cross-references (e.g. arts. 8, 13, 36, 37 to 45, 70, 88 of Lei 12.529) point to the amended law and are not coded as separate relations. Terminology differs: the ementa and operative text say 'obrigações especiais', while the EMI says 'deveres especiais'. The source PDF layout displaces some items: in Art. 47-E II(a) a fragment ('que se refere o art. 88, caput') is misplaced, and the incisos and paragraph of Art. 47-F and the sub-items of Art. 87-G II are out of order, so provisions are cited as printed. Art. 2 sets entry into force 60 days after publication; Art. 87-B §2 starts special obligations 60 days after publication of the decision.

thresholds.value_text: superior a R$ 50.000.000.000,00 (cinquenta bilhões de reais)
thresholds.measurement: Gross annual revenue of the economic group, based on the latest financial statements available on the date the designation administrative process is opened.
thresholds.consequence: Only economic agents whose economic groups exceed this global gross revenue level may be designated as systemically relevant in digital markets.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the national gross revenue test in the same paragraph (either test suffices).

evidence.quote: Somente poderão ser objeto de designação os agentes cujos grupos econômicos tenham registrado faturamento bruto anual global superior a R$ 50.000.000.000,00 (cinquenta bilhões de reais)

thresholds.measurement: Gross annual revenue in Brazil of the economic group, based on the latest financial statements available on the date the designation administrative process is opened.
thresholds.consequence: Only economic agents whose economic groups exceed this national gross revenue level may be designated as systemically relevant in digital markets.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the global gross revenue test in the same paragraph (either test suffices).
